tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Page background. The default ground for all product and marketing pages.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: cards, the swap widget, modals, table bodies.

tokens.name: surface-300
tokens.usage: Sunken or subtle fills: input wells, code blocks, tab tracks, hover rows.

tokens.name: night
tokens.usage: Fixed dark band in BOTH themes: hero, API section, footer. Pair only with on-night text.

tokens.name: night-raised
tokens.usage: Cards and code panels placed on the night band.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on surface-100, surface-200 and surface-300 (14.5:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, table headers on surface-100/200/300 (6.2:1 or better).

tokens.name: on-night
tokens.usage: Text on night and night-raised (16.8:1).

tokens.name: on-night-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on night and night-raised (8.4:1).

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Flow green. Primary buttons, links, active states, key figures. Text on surface-100/200 (4.9:1 light, 10:1 dark).

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of brand fills and links.

tokens.name: brand-tint
tokens.usage: Selected rows, active chips, soft brand backgrounds behind ink text.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brand fill (5.3:1 light, 10.7:1 dark).

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: Signal lime. The accent people remember: hero highlights, the one lime CTA on night, live indicators. Never as text on light surfaces; fill only, with on-signal text.

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text on a signal fill (14.5:1).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card borders. Decorative only, never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and control borders (3.5:1 or better on every surface in both themes).

tokens.name: line-night
tokens.usage: Hairlines on the night band.

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Completed status, price up. Always paired with a word or a + sign, never colour alone.

tokens.name: positive-tint
tokens.usage: Background of positive badges; positive text reads on it.

tokens.name: negative
tokens.usage: Failed status, errors, price down. Always paired with a word, icon or minus sign.

tokens.name: negative-tint
tokens.usage: Background of error badges and field error wells.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Pending, awaiting confirmations, rate expiring.

tokens.name: warning-tint
tokens.usage: Background of pending badges.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral notices, network labels, testnet banners.

tokens.name: info-tint
tokens.usage: Background of info badges and notices.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring, 2px solid with 2px offset (4.5:1 or better on every surface).

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Homepage hero headline only. One per page.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Section headlines on marketing pages; hero on mobile.

styles.name: heading-lg
styles.usage: Section titles in product and docs.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Accept USDT and USDC from customers anywhere and settle to your bank or wallet.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Rates are locked for 30 seconds once you confirm.
styles.usage: Default UI and marketing body copy.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Eyebrow above section headlines. Write the text in capitals.

styles.name: figure-lg
styles.usage: Amounts in the swap widget and dashboard balances.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, badge padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks, chip gaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Input padding, list row gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default gap; mobile page gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding; grid gaps.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Large card padding; desktop gutter.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between a section headline and its content.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Section padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, code tokens, small chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, the swap widget's inner fields.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Swap widget shell, hero panels, large feature tiles.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Asset pills, status dots, segmented controls.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Swap widget and floating panels. Plain cards use a line border instead.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Menus, token pickers, modals.
